summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 9, 2026, reporting two ordinary-course events: a press release announcing follow-on orders from an existing defense customer for observation systems, and board approval of an amended and restated equity incentive plan that increases the share reserve from 800,000 to 2,300,000 ordinary shares. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report without any merger, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation event. No deal terms or special-situation attributes are present.
